description: Java source code for an Android activity demonstrating expandable list views backed by cursors, specifically displaying contacts and their phone numbers.

classes.name: ExpandableList2
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating expandable list of contacts with phone numbers.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: AsyncQueryHandler subclass managing asynchronous database queries for contact data.

classes.name: MyExpandableListAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter extending SimpleCursorTreeAdapter to provide child cursors for contact phone numbers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the adapter, and starts the contact query.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by closing cursors and nullifying the adapter.

methods.name: getChildrenCursor
methods.description: Provides a cursor for the phone numbers of a specific contact group.
